legalAcceptableUse.appliesToEveryPerson: This policy applies to every person who signs into Kairos: members of Kharis Church, fellowship and department leaders, branch administrators, and any volunteer or member of staff who has been granted access. By signing in you confirm you have read and will follow this policy.
legalAcceptableUse.chooseAPasswordYouDoNotUse: Choose a password you do not use anywhere else, and where offered, turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA).
legalAcceptableUse.discussPersonalDetailsOfIndividualMember: Discuss personal details of individual members outside meetings where that discussion is genuinely necessary for their pastoral care.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotAttemptToBypassDisable: Do not attempt to bypass, disable or interfere with any security control in Kairos, including permission checks, rate limits, or audit logging.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotAttemptToReverseEngineer: Do not attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or automate Kairos in ways that were not intended, or run software against it that we have not published.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotConnectYourAccountToThirdParty: Do not connect your Kairos account to third-party services (browser extensions, integrations, bots) unless we have listed that integration as supported.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotShareYourKairosPassword: Do not share your Kairos password with anyone, including your spouse, children, or a leader. If a leader needs information, they have their own account.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotSignInWithSomeoneElses: Do not sign in with someone else’s account, and do not ask anyone to sign in with yours.
legalAcceptableUse.doNotUploadAnythingYouKnow: Do not upload anything you know or suspect contains malware, or any file whose purpose is to damage, disrupt or gain unauthorised access to Kairos or any device connecting to it.
legalAcceptableUse.downloadScreenshotPrintForwardOrCopy: Download, screenshot, print, forward, or copy member data to any personal device, personal email account, or personal spreadsheet, unless a leader has specifically asked you to as part of your role and you delete the copy when you are done.
legalAcceptableUse.followUpThroughPastoralProcesses: Follow up through the church’s pastoral and disciplinary processes.
legalAcceptableUse.harassBullyInsultOrDiscriminateAgainst: Harass, bully, insult or discriminate against anyone.
legalAcceptableUse.ifYouAreEverUnsure: If you are ever unsure whether something you are about to do is acceptable, please pause and ask a leader or contact us at

legalAcceptableUse.intro: Kairos is the internal platform Kharis Church uses to keep in touch with its members, run fellowships and departments, and support pastoral care. Because Kairos holds real information about real people, everyone who signs in agrees to a shared set of rules for how they will behave inside the platform. This policy sets out those rules.
legalAcceptableUse.isTheAgreementThatGoverns: is the agreement that governs your use of Kairos; and
legalAcceptableUse.kairosExistsToBuildUpTheChurch: Kairos exists to build up the church family. When you interact with other members through Kairos (for example messaging a fellowship, updating notes about a follow-up, or posting an announcement) you must not:
legalAcceptableUse.kairosMayShowYouPersonalInformation: Kairos may show you personal information about other members, for example the phone number of someone in your fellowship, a new-believer’s discipleship notes, or a child’s emergency contact. That information is entrusted to you for one purpose only: to help you serve your role in the church.
legalAcceptableUse.lockOrSignOutOfKairos: Lock or sign out of Kairos when you leave a shared device unattended.
legalAcceptableUse.makeCommitmentsInTheNameOf: Make commitments in the name of Kharis Church unless you have been authorised to do so.
legalAcceptableUse.metaDescription: How members are expected to use Kairos, the internal Kharis Church platform.
legalAcceptableUse.removeAnyLeadershipOrAdministrativeRole: Remove any leadership or administrative role you hold within the platform.
legalAcceptableUse.reportSeriousMisuseToTheIco: Report serious misuse to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office, the Police, or another regulator where the law requires it.
legalAcceptableUse.setsOutHowTheChurchHandlesData: sets out how the church handles your personal data;
legalAcceptableUse.shareMemberDataWithAnyoneOutside: Share member data with anyone outside Kharis Church, including family, friends, other churches, or external services without written approval from a Branch Administrator or the Data Protection contact.
legalAcceptableUse.someBreachesParticularlyOnesThatInvolve: Some breaches, particularly ones that involve the personal data of others, may also amount to offences under the UK Data Protection Act 2018 or the Computer Misuse Act 1990, for which you could be personally liable.
legalAcceptableUse.specialCareAppliesToSafeguardingNotes: Special care applies to safeguarding notes, information about children, health information, and information about someone’s personal or family circumstances. Treat these with the highest level of confidentiality.
legalAcceptableUse.suspendOrWithdrawYourAccessTo: Suspend or withdraw your access to Kairos, or to specific parts of it.
legalAcceptableUse.theUkDataProtectionActSuffix: , the UK Data Protection Act 2018, and the UK GDPR.
legalAcceptableUse.thisDocumentIsAnInitialDraft: This document is an initial draft, adapted from the existing Kharis Ministries Acceptable Use of Assets Policy so that it fits the way Kairos is used day to day. It has not yet been reviewed by Kharis Church leadership. Please treat it as a starting point rather than a settled policy.

legalAcceptableUse.uploadSexuallyExplicitViolentHatefulOr: Upload sexually explicit, violent, hateful or illegal material of any kind.
legalAcceptableUse.useKairosForPersonalBusinessGambling: Use Kairos for personal business, gambling, political campaigning or paid promotion.
legalAcceptableUse.useMemberDetailsYouSeeIn: Use member details you see in Kairos for personal reasons, business activity, political campaigning, or evangelism outside the flow of your ministry role.
legalAcceptableUse.useProfanityObsceneLanguageOrContent: Use profanity, obscene language, or content that would embarrass or harm anyone if it were shared.
